Looking at this problem, I need to analyze the verification failure in `HelperA.dfy`.

The lemma `Prove` needs to show that `K.Cut(s,K.Cut(t,x)) == K.Cut(s+t,x)`.

From `Kernel.dfy`, I can see that `Cut(t,x)` returns:
- `0` if `x <= t`
- `x-t` if `x > t`

Let me trace through the cases:

**Case 1: `x <= t`**
- `K.Cut(t,x) == 0` (by `O.Below(t,x)`)
- `K.Cut(s, 0) == 0` (since `0 <= s`, we have `0 <= s`, so by `O.Below(s,0)`)
- `K.Cut(s+t,x) == 0` (since `x <= t <= s+t`, by `O.Below(s+t,x)`)
- So both sides equal `0`. ✓

**Case 2: `x > t`**
- `K.Cut(t,x) == x-t` (by `O.Above(t,x)`)
- Now I need `K.Cut(s, x-t)`:
  - If `x-t <= s`: `K.Cut(s, x-t) == 0` and we need `K.Cut(s+t,x) == 0`. Since `x-t <= s` means `x <= s+t`, so `O.Below(s+t,x)` gives us `K.Cut(s+t,x) == 0`. ✓
  - If `x-t > s`: `K.Cut(s, x-t) == (x-t)-s == x-t-s` and we need `K.Cut(s+t,x) == x-(s+t) == x-s-t`. Since `x-t > s` means `x > s+t`, so `O.Above(s+t,x)` gives us the result. ✓

The current code doesn't handle the sub-cases properly when `x > t`. I need to split the `x > t` case into two sub-cases based on whether `x-t <= s` or `x-t > s`.

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "\n    if x <= t {\n      O.Below(t,x);\n      O.Below(s,0);\n      O.Below(s+t,x);\n    } else {\n      O.Above(t,x);\n      if x - t <= s {\n        O.Below(s, x-t);\n        O.Below(s+t, x);\n      } else {\n        O.Above(s, x-t);\n        O.Above(s+t, x);\n      }\n    }\n  "
}
```
